title: Adversarial Diffusion Distillation
tldr_zh: hinge-GAN 判别器 + SDS 型 score 蒸馏把 SD/SDXL 压到 1–4 步；人评中 ADD-XL 一步胜 LCM-XL 四步、四步胜 SDXL 五十步。
tldr_en: ADD combines a DINOv2-feature hinge GAN with an SDS-equivalent teacher denoising loss to distill SD/SDXL into 1-4 steps; ADD-XL beats LCM-XL (4 steps) in one step and SDXL (50 steps) in four steps by human preference.
key_numbers: COCO FID-5k (SD1.5 base): ADD-M 1 step 19.7 / CLIP 0.326 vs DPM Solver 25 steps 20.1 / 0.318 (Table 2)
Ablation: L_adv only 20.8, L_distill only 315.6, both (exp) 20.6 (Table 1d)
Random student init collapses: FID 293.6 vs 20.6 pretrained (Table 1c)
DINOv2 ViT-S discriminator features best: 20.6 vs CLIP ViT-L 23.3 (Table 1a)
User study: ADD-XL 1 step > LCM-XL 4 steps; ADD-XL 4 steps > SDXL 50 steps in majority (Figs. 5-7)
lambda = 2.5, R1 gamma = 1e-5, N = 4 student timesteps, tau_4 = 1000 (Sec. 3, 4)
Appendix A: distillation loss with c(t)=alpha_t w(t)/(2 sigma_t) equals SDS gradient
